audit_items.proof_trace: The MaxBlobsPerBlock function performs lazy in-place sorting of BlobSchedule (lines 707-709) without synchronization, creating a TOCTOU race where concurrent block validations may read inconsistent max blob limits during the sort operation, potentially allowing blocks with excess commitments to pass validation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker floods P2P with blocks at epoch boundaries when BlobSchedule is unsorted. Concurrent validations in validateDenebBeaconBlock may call MaxBlobsPerBlock during the sort operation, reading incorrect limits and accepting blocks with commitment counts exceeding the true epoch-dependent maximum.
